name: spec
description: Spec pipeline v7 — a small code program run by a trusted engineer, verified by executed evidence. Full lifecycle: greenfield genesis (/spec:genesis; BRIEF ratifies the /spec:mocks approved set) → roadmap briefs → /spec:sketch → /spec:plan → /spec:run (design when due, then build, then review, each `--via loop`; /spec:design, /spec:build, and /spec:review remain each stage's direct entry, spec-build-driver.js and spec-review-driver.js stepped: admission, wave derivation, gate resolution, red-check, the final gate, scope-reconcile, legs via review-legs.js + ONE fresh-context reviewer whose non-soft findings carry executed repros, and verdict derived by verdict.js, with test-author dispatch, per-wave worker dispatch, repair, reviewer dispatch, and dispositions held by the session) → /spec:release, plus /spec:atlas, /spec:status, /spec:doctor, /spec:enforce, /spec:escape, /spec:replay. Changelog (last 3): 7.108.0 — genesis BRIEF drops its `design/tokens.css` precondition and its composed-but-unpicked `## Dissents` check — the theme pick moved to /spec:sketch, which runs after genesis, so neither artifact exists when BRIEF runs; the not-yet-approved `next:` line and its doctrine twin stop enumerating the mocks chain, naming APPROVED instead [no-ac: review's version-bump check is the oracle]. 7.107.0 — Second split of tests/mocks/mocks-driver-2.test.js: the look-probe, capture-gate, and kit-gate tests moved verbatim to mocks-driver-4.test.js after the per-file 45 s budget guard tripped under full-suite load (the file summed ~25 s alone); test count unchanged at 1328. 7.106.0 — the at-risk selector no longer hands ignored working copies to a host's test command: `scope-reconcile.js`'s `walkTestFiles` derives an ignored-path set once per process from `git ls-files -o -i --exclude-standard --directory -z` (guarded to only apply when `--root` is the repository top level and both git calls exit clean), pruning git-ignored directories and files during the walk while leaving the four existing name skips (`.git`, `node_modules`, `fixtures`, `__fixtures__`) untouched; `--probe-at-risk` inherits the same prune through the shared call. `review-legs.js` widens the at-risk and suite legs' forcing predicate from an observed `testsExecuted === 0` to also cover `{"unavailable":"pattern-no-match"}` — a host that declares a test-count format and never matches it now reds both legs instead of passing a run that executed nothing; a host declaring no format at all is unaffected.
